passages.provision_quote: it shall not be a defense, and the defendant may not assert, that the artificial intelligence autonomously caused the harm to the plaintiff
passages.note: Bars the autonomous-AI defense, keeping developers/modifiers/users legally responsible for harm their AI causes.

rows.reasoning: AB 316 (2025-2026), authored by Krell and signed into law October 13, 2025, adds Civil Code Section 1714.46 barring a defendant who developed, modified, or used AI from claiming the AI 'autonomously caused the harm' as a defense. This single-subject provision matches rung 3's text, 'Hold AI developers legally responsible when their systems cause harm,' and excludes the voluntary-guidelines, safety-testing, and pre-approval clauses of the other rungs.
